description: Machine format (wr.event.v1, testnet): the scheduled-event coverage calendar and brief index (id, version, event, sla_met). Use event_brief_get for one brief's full sealed envelope once you have its id. Returns the calendar plus a brief index only — id, version, published_at, event, sla_met per brief — not the full envelopes. Takes no parameters. If the store file is absent on this deployment, the calendar and briefs are empty with a note. Behaviour: read-only and public — no authentication; every call is logged in aggregate (tool name, result count, coarse client class; no IP addresses).
name: event_briefs_list
title: List Event Briefs (Machine Format)
